jobs.tierReason: review of a command that starts a dev server and a browser from profile settings, reads project files and writes evidence that gates ticket completion
jobs.prompt: Review tools/ui-check.mjs, tools/ui-compare.mjs, tools/png-signature.mjs and coordination/review/ui-check.diff against docs/plans/ui-check-design.md. Rules that must hold: (1) the command only runs what the owner put in the profile (ui.start argv, the fixed browser script) and a worker cannot change the profile, the start script or the package.json script it runs (check the existing guards cover the new ui key and ui.start); no shell; minimal environment (no tokens); the browser script is fixed text with all values in a JSON spec file; (2) network scope: the page and mockup URLs can only be this machine (base url checks: userinfo, ports, IPv6, redirects, a route that smuggles a host such as //evil.com or a scheme; the mockup is a file URL of a plain project file with no symlink and no path outside the project, also through the real path, and a mockup html that itself loads remote resources is only rendered, never fetched by the swarm); (3) process hygiene: the dev server and the browser script are always killed (process group, timeouts, errors, the signal path), a server that was already running is never killed, temp files are removed, output sizes are bounded; (4) the evidence that gates ticket completion (.swarm/ui/results.json) cannot be forged or replayed by a worker: who can write that file, is the timestamp rule (at or after integratedAt) sound, can an old pass be reused for new code (the head commit is recorded but is it checked), what if clocks differ, what if the file is a symlink or huge or not JSON; (5) the PNG decoder is safe on hostile input (decompression bombs, huge dimensions, truncated or lying chunks, filter bugs, integer overflow, CRC), and the comparison cannot be fooled trivially into a pass (blank pages, same-colour pages, tiny viewport); (6) compareScreen: each hard rule is correct and cannot throw on odd metrics (missing arrays, NaN, non-string fonts); (7) the sync change and ticket field screens: ids validated, included in the approval hash, a ticket cannot name a screen to skip a check that should apply. Find real bugs with file and line evidence, rank high, medium, low, and say how to fix each. Do not edit files.
